svg.title: KV cache slots
svg.desc: Request C uses block 9 and block 4. Each block has 16 slots, numbered block ID times 16 plus the offset, so C14 and C15 sit in slots 158 and 159 and C16 sits in slot 64. One slot holds the K and V vectors of one token for all KV heads. Every layer has its own KV cache tensor, and all layers write C14 to the same slot 158.
svg.text: A slot is one token cell of the KV cache
block_size 16 · slot = block ID × 16 + offset in block
1 · Request C uses block 9 then block 4
C15 and C16 are neighbors in request C but sit in different blocks
2 · One slot is a logical address: the K and V of one token for every KV head
K and V are head_size values each · slot 158 → block 158 // 16 = 9, offset 158 % 16 = 14
logical view: one slot = kv_cache[9, :, 14], where ":" takes every head
physical memory: [num_blocks, num_kv_heads, block_size, 2 × head_size] puts the head axis before
the offset, so the heads of one slot are not next to each other
3 · Every layer has its own tensor, and all use the same slot number
